title: Insert the SIM card into the Pro-finder module
body_md: Then take the prepared card out of the mobile device, insert it into the holder on the Pro-finder circuit board and lock the holder.
source_region: Section 2.2, body text above the photo
prev_context: Before this stands the caution box on iPhone and iMessages.
